patch_description: Gen 10 showed local search hurt (289 vs 276) by consuming budget. This edit removes Phase 2 (iterated local search) entirely and converts all remaining time into additional beam search restarts with progressively larger beam widths. A wall-clock budget check drives dynamic restart count: keep running restarts with growing beam width until the budget expires. Beam search with full lookahead expansion is the demonstrably effective search dimension, so all compute goes there.
